Import GBIF-style occurrence records

geo_gbif.Rd

Accepts a pre-downloaded GBIF (or rgbif-like) data frame, or downloads records with rgbif when it is installed. The result is standardised to species, lon, lat and optional extras, then optionally passed through geo_clean() and geo_as_sf().

Usage

geo_gbif(
  data = NULL,
  scientificName = NULL,
  country = NULL,
  limit = 500,
  clean = TRUE,
  as_sf = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

data

Optional data frame already holding GBIF columns such as decimalLongitude, decimalLatitude and species / scientificName.

scientificName, country, limit

Arguments forwarded to rgbif::occ_search() when data is NULL.

clean

Run geo_clean()?

as_sf

Convert cleaned points with geo_as_sf()?

...

Passed to geo_clean() when clean = TRUE.

Value

A tibble, or an sf tibble when as_sf = TRUE.

Examples

gbif_like <- tibble::tibble(
  scientificName = "Camponotus",
  decimalLongitude = 147.1,
  decimalLatitude = -9.4,
  countryCode = "PG"
)
geo_gbif(gbif_like, clean = FALSE, as_sf = FALSE)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 4
#>   species      lon   lat countryCode
#>   <chr>      <dbl> <dbl> <chr>      
#> 1 Camponotus  147.  -9.4 PG
